ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, $a \\parallel b$, if $\\angle 1=50^\\circ$, then what is the measure of $\\angle 2$ in degrees?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} As shown in the figure, \\
$\because a \parallel b$, \\
$\therefore \angle 3 = \angle 1$, \\
$\because \angle 1 = 50^\circ$, \\
$\therefore \angle 3 = 50^\circ$ \\
$\because \angle 2 + \angle 3 = 180^\circ$ \\
$\therefore \angle 2 = 180^\circ - \angle 3 = 180^\circ - 50^\circ = \boxed{130^\circ}$
